defmodule CryptoVault.CircuitBreaker do
  @moduledoc """
  Circuit breaker for cryptographic operations with key rotation support.
  Prevents cascade failures when HSM is unavailable.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_failures 5
  @reset_timeout 30_000
  @key_check_interval 5_000

  defstruct [
    :state,
    :failure_count,
    :last_failure_time,
    :current_key_id,
    :key_metadata,
    :pending_operations
  ]

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(_opts) do
    schedule_key_check()
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{
      state: :closed,
      failure_count: 0,
      last_failure_time: nil,
      current_key_id: nil,
      key_metadata: %{},
      pending_operations: :queue.new()
    }}
  end

  @doc "Encrypt data using the current active key with circuit breaker protection"
  def encrypt(plaintext, opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:encrypt, plaintext, opts}, 10_000)
  end

  @doc "Verify key is still valid and perform encryption"
  def verified_encrypt(plaintext, required_key_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:verified_encrypt, plaintext, required_key_id}, 10_000)
  end

  def handle_call({:encrypt, plaintext, opts}, from, state) do
    case state.state do
      :open ->
        if should_attempt_reset?(state) do
          attempt_operation(plaintext, opts, from, %{state | state: :half_open})
        else
          {:reply, {:error, :circuit_open}, state}
        end

      :half_open ->
        {:reply, {:error, :circuit_half_open}, state}

      :closed ->
        attempt_operation(plaintext, opts, from, state)
    end
  end

  def handle_call({:verified_encrypt, plaintext, required_key_id}, _from, state) do
    # Step 1: Verify the key_id matches what caller expects
    validated_key_id = validate_key_id(required_key_id, state)

    # Step 2: Perform the actual encryption using the validated key
    # NOTE: Between validation and use, a key rotation may have occurred
    # via the scheduled key_check message handler
    result = perform_crypto_operation(plaintext, validated_key_id, state)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  def handle_info(:key_check, state) do
    new_state = refresh_key_metadata(state)
    schedule_key_check()
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  def handle_info({:key_rotated, new_key_id, metadata}, state) do
    Logger.info("Key rotated to #{new_key_id}")
    new_state = %{state |
      current_key_id: new_key_id,
      key_metadata: Map.put(state.key_metadata, new_key_id, metadata)
    }
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  # Private functions

  defp validate_key_id(required_key_id, state) do
    cond do
      required_key_id == nil ->
        state.current_key_id

      required_key_id == state.current_key_id ->
        required_key_id

      Map.has_key?(state.key_metadata, required_key_id) ->
        # Key exists in metadata, allow usage even if not current
        # This enables graceful rotation
        required_key_id

      true ->
        # Fallback: use current key if requested key unknown
        state.current_key_id
    end
  end

  defp perform_crypto_operation(plaintext, key_id, state) do
    # Fetch the key material - this reads from ETS which may have been
    # updated by a concurrent key rotation process
    case fetch_key_material(key_id) do
      {:ok, key_material} ->
        iv = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16)
        # The key_material fetched here may not correspond to key_id
        # if rotation happened between validate_key_id and fetch_key_material
        ciphertext = :crypto.crypto_one_time(:aes_256_gcm, key_material, iv, plaintext, true)
        {:ok, %{ciphertext: ciphertext, iv: iv, key_id: key_id}}

      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp fetch_key_material(key_id) do
    # Read from shared ETS table - subject to concurrent modification
    case :ets.lookup(:crypto_vault_keys, :active_key_material) do
      [{:active_key_material, material, stored_key_id}] ->
        # BUG: We fetch active_key_material but don't verify stored_key_id == key_id
        # A rotation between validate_key_id and here causes key_id mismatch
        # The returned metadata says key_id X but actual encryption used key Y
        {:ok, material}

      [] ->
        {:error, :no_key_available}
    end
  end

  defp attempt_operation(plaintext, _opts, _from, state) do
    case perform_crypto_operation(plaintext, state.current_key_id, state) do
      {:ok, result} ->
        {:reply, {:ok, result}, %{state | state: :closed, failure_count: 0}}

      {:error, reason} ->
        new_state = record_failure(state, reason)
        {:reply, {:error, reason}, new_state}
    end
  end

  defp record_failure(state, _reason) do
    new_count = state.failure_count + 1
    new_state = %{state |
      failure_count: new_count,
      last_failure_time: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    }

    if new_count >= @max_failures do
      Logger.warning("Circuit breaker opened after #{new_count} failures")
      %{new_state | state: :open}
    else
      new_state
    end
  end

  defp should_attempt_reset?(state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    now - state.last_failure_time >= @reset_timeout
  end

  defp refresh_key_metadata(state) do
    case :ets.lookup(:crypto_vault_keys, :key_registry) do
      [{:key_registry, registry}] ->
        %{state | key_metadata: registry}
      [] ->
        state
    end
  end

  defp schedule_key_check do
    Process.send_after(self(), :key_check, @key_check_interval)
  end
end
